fields.description: Identifier minted by the kiosk on the DEVICE at capture time, before any network call. It is what makes photo registration idempotent across an offline queue that retries: the same capture re-posted after a dropped connection updates its row instead of creating a second one.
fields.label: Client Capture ID

fields.description: Pending = captured on the device, bytes not yet on the server. Uploaded = the File exists here. Failed = the device gave up after repeated attempts. A Pending photo still SATISFIES the capture gate — the photo was taken, and stranding a technician on a site because an upload is failing is not a trade this rollout can afford.
fields.label: Upload Status

fields.description: When the photo was taken on the device, not when it reached the server. The two can be hours apart on a site with no signal.
fields.label: Captured On

fields.description: Device-side upload attempts. Mirrors the sync_attempts counter already on Job Interval so the two retry loops read the same way.
fields.label: Upload Attempts

fields.description: Blank until the bytes arrive. Attach Image rather than Attach so the grid renders a thumbnail — the whole point is that somebody can see the job without opening anything.
fields.label: Photo

fields.description: The File document behind the image. Held explicitly so the Drive mirror and the Project fan-out have a stable handle even if file_url is later rewritten.
fields.label: File
